863e0183.text:
To face Frostmaw, you must entice him with the meat of his favorite prey.

Go to the Alterac Mountains in Azeroth and hunt a hulking mountain lion.  Kill it, and then take its carcass to the Growless Cave, a place held sacred by the bestial wendigo.

Place the carcass on the Flame of Uzel and the scent from burning meat will drift from the cave.

And then, in time, Frostmaw will come.
863e0183.title: Kodo Skin Scroll

aa570d62.text:
Commander Primwell Skye

Commander Skye's studies in military theory during her tenure as archivist bolstered Lordaeron's strategy during the Second War.  After serving as tactician on the Arathi front, she retired to a farmstead on the land she helped reclaim for humanity.
aa570d62.title: Archivists of the Monastery

dce1b1cf.text: As the politics and rivalries of the seven human nations waxed and waned, the line of Guardians kept its constant vigil against chaos. There were many Guardians over the years, but only one ever held the magical powers of Tirisfal at any given time. One of the last Guardians of the age distinguished herself as a mighty warrior against the shadow.
dce1b1cf.title: Aegwynn and the Dragon Hunt

10278|b24d3eb1.name: Thrag Stonehoof
10278|b24d3eb1.text: I listen and I listen but I don't hear these spirits that Karn speaks of.

11044|386a9ec7.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|386a9ec7.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $N, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

11802|ef8483c2.name: Dendrite Starblaze
11802|ef8483c2.text:
Greetings, $c.  You are welcome in Nighthaven, as well as all of Moonglade.  The Cenarion Circle welcomes all beings who respect the authority and command of nature.

While you are here, please be sure to preserve the balance in all things.  Disturbances are not welcome here, and our wardens are trained to cease all hostilities without question.

11833|383e75cd.name: Rahauro
11833|383e75cd.text: Please, feel free to speak to me anytime, $N. You have served Magatha well. I am sure she will call upon you in the future.

11833|eb2e4319.name: Rahauro
11833|eb2e4319.text:
Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

11869|49ff395c.name: Ansekhwa
11869|49ff395c.text: I would be honored to train you in the use of the weapons that I have mastered should you have the ability to learn within you.

11901|c5ceacbe.name: Andruk
11901|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

11956|0359e6b8.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|0359e6b8.text:
Strength of the heart is what gives you the resolve to take action... action that is rooted in intents that are pure and forthright.  To keep the balance is not to be complacent or banal.

You must show resolve for that which you believe in, and you must be willing to fight for it.  The mother bear shows endless conviction in protecting her young, as does an elder bear protecting his den.  It is this resolve, this strength of heart, which you must come to know if you are to master the way of the Claw.

11956|2c9200b5.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|2c9200b5.text:
I represent the strength which bolsters you as a young $c.  You have come to me to learn this strength, young one, and I will teach this to you.  I will teach you all that is the spirit bear, provided you will listen and understand.

In order to know what it means to draw upon my spirit, you need to understand the importance of the strength of the body, as well as the strength of the heart.

11956|59f9a1e9.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|59f9a1e9.text:
It remains to be seen if you are ready, young one.  Even the wisest and oldest of druids are never truly ready when their ultimate time of testing comes.

You have heard my words, and now you must move on.  Heed what I have taught you.  There will be a time when you will have your strength tested.  You must face your foe as the bear would - with strength of body and with strength of heart.  Learn from the fight, young one.  Go... with my blessings.

11956|86efb831.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|86efb831.text:
The bear spirit looks upon you with a calm and peaceful gaze.  You hear a voice speak to you as though it was coming from the bear, but the creature makes no indication that it is speaking.

"Greetings, my young friend.  If you have come to me seeking guidance, then perhaps I can help you find what you seek."

11956|d6a631ca.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|d6a631ca.text:
Strength of the body is the power and swiftness of action.  You must keep yourself fit at all times, both physically and mentally.  The bear's girth highlights its strength, as it is a ferocious foe in combat.  The bear's girth, however, belies its lithe agility and sharp mind.  These are surprises you will use to your advantage.

You must rely on the strength of the bear's body in order to master the way of the Claw.

12144|8e6ce242.name: Lunaclaw Spirit
12144|8e6ce242.text:
The spirit looks intently into your eyes and grasps your hand.  You feel a warmth shoot through your body, almost knocking you to your knees.

As the warmth passes, you feel the slight presence of an ursine spirit within your being... bolstering your resolve.

12144|ac452739.name: Lunaclaw Spirit
12144|ac452739.text: The slain spirit of Lunaclaw stares at you intently, as though wanting something from you.

12616|c5ceacbe.name: Vhulgra
12616|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12696|f1d5ba87.name: Senani Thunderheart
12696|f1d5ba87.text: Do you hear the call of the hunt, $c?  You must listen closely, but the call comes from deep within you.  It comes from deep within all of us.

12724|39b67c2e.name: Pixel
12724|39b67c2e.text: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

12736|e3f9a765.name: Je'neu Sancrea
12736|e3f9a765.text: The elements speak to us, $c.  They share knowledge that we must learn, and they share secrets that must be kept.

13085|412e073b.name: Myrokos Silentform
13085|412e073b.text:
We are all pieces of a much larger puzzle, $N. Just as you guide the piece of a puzzle to its destination, so too are we guided by another.

And perhaps they who guide us are themselves guided by an even greater force.

1387|c5ceacbe.name: Thysta
1387|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

14728|b050140a.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
14728|b050140a.text:
Hail brother... I'd like a moment of your time, if I may.

We $r have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing our homeland.  We now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of $r everywhere in helping us out!

1515|778f03ac.name: Executor Zygand
1515|778f03ac.text: The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland. The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2055|288436fb.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
2055|288436fb.text: The Royal Apothecary Society shall heed The Dark Lady's call to uncover the New Plague and drive Arthas and his heathen Scourge Army from the world once and for all.

2216|8e0e34da.name: Apothecary Lydon
2216|8e0e34da.text: We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2389|c5ceacbe.name: Zarise
2389|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

250686|3c4152a4.name: Tabitha Heartweaver
250686|3c4152a4.text: Praise to the Banshee Queen, it isn't often I have visitors out here.

266484|e94c420f.name: Morbin Lightbane
266484|e94c420f.text:
We paladins must earn our place amongst our Forsaken kin each day, lest we be judged as fanatics like the Scarlet Crusade. The light is not simply a tool of our foes, but a conduit for our righteous fury! It is in our devotion to the Dark Lady and the love of our home that we may channel the light to bring justice to our enemies.

The Banshee Queen keeps a close eye on us. Let her. She will see that our resolve shall never waver. We are Forsaken!

2706|368f0fed.name: Tor'gan
2706|368f0fed.text: Thanks to the Warchief, even here in the ruins of our former prison, some hope remains, and the Horde rises anew.

271613|f87677dc.name: Unfinished Abomination
271613|f87677dc.text: <The body looks incomplete and appears to be awaiting a head.>

2851|c5ceacbe.name: Urda
2851|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3033|8fca8484.name: Turak Runetotem
3033|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

3033|b554cff6.name: Turak Runetotem
3033|b554cff6.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.

It never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.

3036|d1e27715.name: Kym Wildmane
3036|d1e27715.text: $N, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

3057|690a7170.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057|690a7170.text:
Greetings young one, and welcome to Thunder Bluff.  You'll find safe refuge from the burdens of the world here.  All denizens of the Horde are welcome here.

The spirits of the present and past come alive here in this sacred place, my friend.  Honor them, and in doing so honor yourself.

3064|8223e188.name: Gennia Runetotem
3064|8223e188.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

We are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Cenarius has taught us.  Never forget this.

3084|a93675fd.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|a93675fd.text: Ah, you seek the wisdom of Ansekhwa.  Look for him on the lower rise at Thunder Bluff Weapons.

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3401|08830bac.name: Shenthul
3401|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3401|8830368a.name: Shenthul
3401|8830368a.text:
The Shattered Hand's influence dominates these lands. We are the veil which covers Kalimdor: The protectorates, the police, the judges, the jury, and ultimately, the executioners. We see all, we know all.

You have grown much in the time which you have spent in service of the Hand, $N. The time has come to send you into the field.

Are you prepared to undertake your next mission?

3412|d0fc10c2.name: Nogg
3412|d0fc10c2.text: If there were just a few more hours in a day...

3413|c879b3f9.name: Sovik
3413|c879b3f9.text: Hello, $N! If you don't see it in my shop, chances are good I can get it!

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3549|1d35a5a1.name: Shelene Rhobart
3549|1d35a5a1.text: You've got the hang of it. I can't teach you any more, but talk to Arthur Moore, a Forsaken who works in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity. Tell him I sent you.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4582|08830bac.name: Carolyn Ward
4582|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

4582|0deb5cc3.name: Carolyn Ward
4582|0deb5cc3.text: With the sanction of Lord Varimathras, the Deathstalkers' numbers grow. More blades to strike at our enemies when they least expect it.

4582|6634d541.name: Carolyn Ward
4582|6634d541.text: The Syndicate keeps many locked boxes of supplies in Durnholde Keep in Hillsbrad.

4583|0deb5cc3.name: Miles Dexter
4583|0deb5cc3.text: With the sanction of Lord Varimathras, the Deathstalkers' numbers grow. More blades to strike at our enemies when they least expect it.

4584|0deb5cc3.name: Gregory Charles
4584|0deb5cc3.text: With the sanction of Lord Varimathras, the Deathstalkers' numbers grow. More blades to strike at our enemies when they least expect it.

4591|43457c57.name: Mary Edras
4591|43457c57.text: Balai Lok'Wein of Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh sells a manual that you will need to study in order to improve your skills!

4631|66df9383.name: Wharfmaster Lozgil
4631|66df9383.text:
So you're here for the Warsong axes. Well, it's about time, $N. That crate has been sitting out there for days, now.

Feel free to haul it away whenever you are ready.

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

5759|43457c57.name: Nurse Neela
5759|43457c57.text: Balai Lok'Wein of Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh sells a manual that you will need to study in order to improve your skills!

5769|c9ae2675.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
5769|c9ae2675.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6746|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Pala
6746|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

6766|af742dd2.name: Ravenholdt Guard
6766|af742dd2.text: Greetings, $c. Have you spoken with Fahrad yet?

6766|b8f82c44.name: Ravenholdt Guard
6766|b8f82c44.text: It is good to see you again, $N.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

9087|e4fd33dd.name: Bashana Runetotem
9087|e4fd33dd.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

9501|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Adegwa
9501|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

1136-progress.name: Melor Stonehoof
1136-progress.text: Have you been to the Alterac Mountains, $N?  Did you face the elusive Frostmaw?
1136-progress.title: Frostmaw

1195-progress.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-progress.text: Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.
1195-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

24-progress.name: Senani Thunderheart
24-progress.text: Greetings once again, $N!  Have you come to show me proof of your hunt?
24-progress.title: Shadumbra's Head

3369-progress.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3369-progress.title: In Nightmares

501-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-progress.text: I remember you, $N.  You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir.  I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.
501-progress.title: Elixir of Pain

513-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
513-progress.text: Can you not see I am busy, $c?  The Dark Lady insists on a new plague before the Scourge advance from Northrend overwhelms us.  And with the human threat pressing from the south, time becomes my most precious commodity.  This better be important!
513-progress.title: Elixir of Agony

547-progress.name: Deathguard Humbert
547-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve my sword, $N?  High Executor Darthalia will hang me from the rafters if she discovers my folly.
547-progress.title: Humbert's Sword

6441-progress.name: Pixel
6441-progress.text: I hope you can be quick about getting those horns, $N. I'm heading back to Ratchet soon!
6441-progress.title: Satyr Horns

6504-progress.name: Gurda Ragescar
6504-progress.text: I hope you find the pages soon, $N! I really need to get back to work!
6504-progress.title: The Lost Pages

6571-progress.name: Locke Okarr
6571-progress.text: I hope you can come through with the supplies! I'm in big trouble if I don't deliver them soon!
6571-progress.title: Warsong Supplies

6581-progress.name: Pixel
6581-progress.text:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!

What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.

So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
6581-progress.title: Warsong Saw Blades

7820-progress.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
7820-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Thunder Bluff for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7820-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

78676-accept.name: Unknown
78676-accept.text:
<A note sits in the chest>

Glad to have you back, $N.

The latest object of my desire is an artifact known as the Eye of Bhossca. My sources tell me the eye is somewhere within the Scarlet Monastery. As with Shadowfang Keep, you must infiltrate the monastery alone.

It may behoove you to find a disguise before going in. It will make getting around a touch easier. I'm sure you could find something on the monastery's grounds.

Return the eye here, and payment will be delivered as before.

- C
78676-accept.title: The Eye of Bhossca

82208-complete.name: Owen Thadd
82208-complete.text:
Thanks to your donations, the library is thriving.

Please, take this.
82208-complete.title: Greater Friend of the Library

96781-complete.name: Myrokos Silentform
96781-complete.text: It appears you've some light fingers on you, $N. Very good.
96781-complete.title: What's the Big Idea?

96781-progress.name: Myrokos Silentform
96781-progress.text: What are they after in those ruins, I wonder?
96781-progress.title: What's the Big Idea?

96782-accept.name: Myrokos Silentform
96782-accept.text:
It seems our friend Barton here has made this very easy for us. He is after two heirlooms of the Perenolde family within the ruins of Alterac. The Blade of House Perenolde, a sword, and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde, a shield.

From the report, it seems these armaments are within two towers among the ruins. Best we acquire them before the Syndicate does.

The ogres occupying the ruins are fierce, but I trust you should be able to sneak past them without needing to bloody your blade at all.
96782-accept.title: Covert Extraction

96782-complete.name: Myrokos Silentform
96782-complete.text:
Excellent. I will hold these in safekeeping, for now, while I decide what best to do with them.

You are dismissed, $N. Good work.
96782-complete.title: Covert Extraction

96782-progress.name: Myrokos Silentform
96782-progress.text: Odds are we shall have those heirlooms before Barton even notices his reports are missing.
96782-progress.title: Covert Extraction

97485-accept.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-accept.text:
Blessings of An'she, child.

We have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds, and I was wondering if you'd be interested in honoring our tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485-accept.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97985-progress.name: Calder Gray
97985-progress.text: Oh, you've returned in one piece! Pity, if you hadn't your flesh and organs would have made excellent fodder for my tinkering.
97985-progress.title: Thundering Hearts
